title: Design parameter optimization of a membrane reactor for methanol synthesis using a sophisticated CFD model
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, 4,565-577
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00016E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Theresa Hauth, Konstantin Pielmaier, Vincent Dieterich, Nicolas Wein, Hartmut Spliethoff, Sebastian Fendt
A sophisticated CFD model of a membrane reactor for methanol synthesis from CO2 is developed, with which key parameters for the general optimization of the construction and operation of membrane reactors for industrial applications are identified.
